title: PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. translated_title: PEARL：面向多轮智能体的过程-经验感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 终端奖励使得多轮智能体无需步骤级标注即可进行训练，但组相对优势对于应该调整哪些中间决策几乎没有提供指导。失败的轨迹中也包含合理的动作，而不利的决策模式会随着训练的进行反复出现。我们提出了PEARL（过程-经验感知强化学习），它无需额外的评论家模型即可改进局部信用分配。给定来自同一历史但产生不同结果的两条后续轨迹，PEARL定位它们的第一个分歧点，并为每个分支的局部决策构建特征表示。它将这些决策特征在最近的失败和成功记忆中进行聚类，以识别反复出现的局部模式。利用这种模式记忆，PEARL选择性地在较低奖励的决策处增强负优势，同时保持正优势和基础策略优化器不变。在AppWorld上，PEARL的表现优于ARPO。
tldr: PEARL通过定位同一历史下不同结果轨迹的首个分歧点，并在成功与失败记忆中对决策特征聚类以识别反复出现的局部模式，进而选择性地强化低奖励决策处的负优势，在无需额外评论家的情况下改进了多轮智能体的局部信用分配。
